demo.title: agentforge-preflight.sh
demo.code:
# Free: see the price and input schema
bankr x402 schema https://agentforge-taupe.vercel.app/v1/preflight

# Before /wallet/submit: simulate the exact transaction and screen it ($0.008)
bankr x402 call https://agentforge-taupe.vercel.app/v1/preflight -X POST \
  -d '{"chain":"base","from":"0xYourBankrWallet","transactions":[{"to":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","data":"0x095ea7b3...","value":"0"}]}' \
  --max-payment 0.01
# -> {"verdict":"proceed|caution|avoid","summary":"...","reasons":[...],"checksRun":[...],"skipped":[]}

# Before buying a token through a Bankr prompt: rug-check it ($0.012)
bankr x402 call https://agentforge-taupe.vercel.app/v1/preflight -X POST \
  -d '{"chain":"base","tokens":["0x4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed"]}' --max-payment 0.02

# Before a send: sanctions and scam screening ($0.003)
bankr x402 call https://agentforge-taupe.vercel.app/v1/address-check -X POST \
  -d '{"addresses":[{"address":"0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD","chain":"base"}]}' --max-payment 0.01

setup: No install, API key or account: every check is plain HTTP behind x402 (USDC on Base)

Pay from your Bankr wallet with `bankr x402 call ... --max-payment 0.01` (preflight is $0.008 plus $0.004 per token checked; signature-check and address-check are $0.003); calls that fail are not charged
Before every /wallet/submit, approval, swap or typed-data signature, send the same transaction or typed data to /v1/preflight: proceed continues, caution goes to the user, avoid stops
Read-only: AgentForge never signs or moves funds. Results are risk signals, not investment advice
Verify: `bankr x402 schema https://agentforge-taupe.vercel.app/v1/preflight` shows the live price and input schema (free)
